summary: Diff adds new frontend views for monthly summary, 90-day heatmap, and daily goal progress; adds task tags and single-note linking UI for tasks/reminders; introduces a migration and extends backend types for tags, noteId, and dailyStudyGoal. However, several requirements call for new backend methods and persistent per-user data (monthly summary, heatmap aggregates, daily goal get/update, multi-note associations, and expanded shop ownership/purchases) that are not evidenced in the diff and in some cases are implemented only client-side or only with local state.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend support for a Monthly Study Summary (month total minutes + best 7-day week within month) via a new backend method that does not trap on empty months.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend MonthlyStudySummaryView computes monthly totals and best week by filtering sessions from useGetWeeklyStudySessions (client-side). The diff summary shows no new backend method for monthly summaries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Monthly Study Summary UI must fetch data via React Query from the backend monthly-summary method and remain consistent via query invalidation after new sessions are recorded.
missing_requirements.reason: UI uses useGetWeeklyStudySessions and derives month stats locally, rather than fetching a dedicated backend monthly summary for a selected month/year; no query keys/invalidation for a monthly summary are evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend method to fetch per-day aggregated study minutes for at least the last 90 days (with unambiguous day keys and support for continuous range rendering).
missing_requirements.reason: Heatmap UI computes per-day minutes by repeatedly filtering weekly sessions on the client; no backend per-day aggregation method is shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Heatmap UI should load heatmap data via React Query and include an English legend explaining intensity meaning.
missing_requirements.reason: StudyHeatmapView uses useGetWeeklyStudySessions (not a heatmap-specific React Query fetch) and the provided snippet shows no legend component/text explaining intensity levels.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend methods to get/update a per-user daily study goal with validation and sensible default (e.g., 0 meaning no goal set), without trapping for existing users.
missing_requirements.reason: Types and migration add dailyStudyGoal, but the diff summary does not show backend get/update methods or validation logic. Migration sets dailyStudyGoal=60 (not 0/no-goal) for existing users.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (references dailyGoal invalidation but no shown hook definitions)

missing_requirements.requirement: Daily goal progress should use today’s studied minutes across all modes and refresh after recording sessions via query invalidation patterns; if no goal set, prompt to set goal.
missing_requirements.reason: DailyGoalProgressCard computes todayMinutes from useGetWeeklyStudySessions only (may not cover all modes and relies on weekly window) and the diff summary does not show session-recording invalidation tied to goal progress/today totals.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend methods to create/update task tags and list tasks with tags; allow updating tags without affecting unrelated fields; preserve existing tasks via conditional migration.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend Task type includes tags and migration initializes tags=[], but the diff summary does not show backend methods specifically supporting tag updates independent of other fields, nor any explicit API changes beyond type additions.

missing_requirements.requirement: Tasks can be associated with zero or more notes, including linking/unlinking existing notes and creating a new note within task edit flow; handle deleted-note fallback.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend and migration use a single noteId (?Nat) on Task, not zero-or-more notes. Frontend NoteLinker and TodoSection appear designed for one linked note (linkedNoteId singular). No evidence of deleted-note fallback behavior in task rendering.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reminders can be associated with zero or more notes, including link/unlink existing notes and create-and-attach within reminder edit flow; reminder notification behavior unchanged.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend and migration use a single noteId (?Nat) on Reminder, not zero-or-more notes. UI state also uses a single linkedNoteId/editLinkedNoteId. No evidence regarding notification behavior guarantees.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expanded reward shop with at least one new item category beyond backgrounds, with backend-persisted ownership, coin deduction once, repurchase prevention, React Query invalidation, and insufficient-coin blocking with English error.
missing_requirements.reason: RewardShopSection uses local React state (ownedItems Set) and explicitly comments that purchase is simulated and would call backend in a real app. No backend purchase/ownership persistence for new item categories is evidenced; no React Query invalidation after purchase is shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Daily study goal default set to 60 minutes for all existing users during migration.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest suggests a sensible default such as 0 meaning “no goal set”; setting 60 by default changes existing users’ state/UX without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Reward shop implements a client-side simulated purchase/ownership system (ownedItems in local state) without backend integration.
hallucinated_features.reason: The requirement calls for backend-persisted ownership and coin deduction; the added simulated purchase behavior is not requested and may conflict with the intended persistent design.
evidence: frontend/src/components/RewardShopSection.tsx ("Simulate purchase (in real app, this would call backend)")
